title: GraM-Diff: A Unified Graph-Mamba Diffusion Framework for EEG-Based Alzheimer's Disease Data Generation and Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2608.29755v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a promising, non-invasive, and cost-effective modality for Alzheimer's disease (AD) detection, but deep learning methods are limited by small and imbalanced clinical datasets. Generative augmentation offers a solution, yet existing approaches rely on inefficient class-specific models or fail to capture complex spatial and temporal brain dynamics. To address this, we propose GraM-Diff, a unified classifier-guided Graph-Mamba diffusion framework for EEG synthesis. It embeds Graph Convolutional Networks within a diffusion U-Net to model inter-electrode connectivity and Bidirectional Mamba state-space blocks for linear-complexity long-range temporal modeling. Latent-space classifier guidance lets a single model generate both healthy and pathological EEG within a shared representation, avoiding fragmented per-cohort pipelines. Across four EEG-based AD benchmarks, synthetic augmentation improves classification,

translated_title: GraM-Diff：用于基于脑电图的阿尔茨海默病数据生成与诊断的统一Graph-Mamba扩散框架
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）是一种有前景的、无创且低成本的阿尔茨海默病（AD）检测模态，但深度学习方法受到规模小且不平衡的临床数据集的限制。生成式增强提供了一种解决方案，然而现有方法依赖于低效的特定类别模型，或无法捕捉复杂的脑部空间和时间动态。为解决这一问题，我们提出了GraM-Diff，一个用于脑电合成的统一分类器引导Graph-Mamba扩散框架。该框架将图卷积网络嵌入扩散U-Net中以建模电极间连接性，并采用双向Mamba状态空间块实现线性复杂度的长程时间建模。潜在空间分类器引导使单一模型能够在共享表示中生成健康和病理脑电信号，避免了碎片化的按类别划分的流程。在四个基于脑电的阿尔茨海默病基准测试中，合成数据增强提升了分类性能……
tldr: 提出GraM-Diff统一扩散框架，通过图卷积网络建模电极间连接与双向Mamba进行长程时间建模，实现单一模型生成健康与病理脑电数据，有效提升阿尔茨海默病检测性能。
en_tdlr: GraM-Diff, a unified classifier-guided Graph-Mamba diffusion framework combining graph convolutional networks for inter-electrode connectivity modeling and bidirectional Mamba blocks for linear-complexity long-range temporal modeling, enables a single model to generate both healthy and pathological EEG, improving Alzheimer's disease classification across four benchmarks.
